content:
nina: Heads-up — p95 admission latency spiked in hosted-usw2 ~09:12. dashboards show available_headroom falling to ~2% for ~6m.
alertbot: Firing: HostedPoolHeadroomLow - pool=hosted-usw2 - value=0.02 - expr=sum(available_slots)/sum(total_slots) < 0.05 for 5m
ryan: I see this pattern. digging: prewarm jobs are accounting for ~30% of free slots during the dip window.
juno: @ryan can you paste the query? want to know if it's kvcache warmups, model pulls, or orchestration prewarm tasks.
ryan: query snippets: `sum(over_time(prewarm_jobs_active[10m])) by (pool)` and `sum(unused_reserved_slots) by (pool)` — prewarm active > reserved slack in usw2.
maya: Also noticing slot fragmentation. lots of small interactive containers occupy scattered slots so big-batch tasks can't get contiguous GPUs -> admission backs up.
sean: dashboards only show % headroom. that hides fragmentation. we need a contiguous_free_slot_count gauge.
nina: Agreed. right now alerts fire briefly and then recover -> noisy pages. need hysteresis or a better signal to avoid paging ops for <2m blips.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy queued: admission-controller v3.2.1 -> starting rollout in 10m.
juno: Short proposals: 1) emit contiguous_free_slot_count metric 2) add 2m hysteresis to HostedPoolHeadroomLow 3) temporary prewarm concurrency cap per pool 4) add runbook for fragmentation events
ryan: temp mitigation I'd push now: `prewarm.max_concurrent_per_pool=0.15` (15% of idle). reduces prewarm pressure.
maya: note cost/latency tradeoff: capping prewarm will reduce big-batch tail pressure but will increase cold starts for some small RPCs -> may raise p95 for those tenants.
sean: Medium-term idea: soft-priority queueing that allows batch requests to wait up to 20s for contiguous slots while interactive gets small-slot preemption. more invasive but elegant.
nina: For ops short-term: add contiguous metric, add short hysteresis on headroom alert, throttle prewarm. if sustained >1h then postmortem.
alex: I'll own the alert + dashboard patch. sean/juno draft the prewarm cap playbook. ryan will push helm/values change.
ryan: pushing helm diff now: `helm upgrade --install admission-controller -f prewarm-override.yaml`
juno: I'll add a tiny diag dashboard (contiguous_free_slots, prewarm_active, reserved_slots) and a runbook snippet.
nina: :thumbsup: good plan. follow up with impact numbers after rollout. escalate if any tenant p95 increases >5% for 30m.

# snippets we plan to commit:

prewarm-override.yaml:
```yaml
prewarm:
  max_concurrent_per_pool: 0.15
  max_per_node: 2
  backoff_seconds: 30
```

prometheus rule (proposal):
```yaml
- alert: HostedPoolHeadroomLow_v2
  expr: (sum(contiguous_free_slots) by (pool) / sum(total_slots) by (pool)) < 0.05
  for: 2m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "Low contiguous headroom in {{ $labels.pool }}"
    runbook: "/runbooks/hosted-headroom-erosion.md"
```

runbook snippet:
- check contiguous_free_slots graph in /dashboards/hosted/headroom
- if prewarm_active > reserved_slots*0.2 -> apply prewarm cap and monitor for 15m
- if p95 for interactive tenants rises >5% -> rollback cap and open incident

nina: tagging this thread as follow-up for next infra sync.
